bio_am: Ծնած է 1888-ին՝ Ալափարս գիւղը։ 1913-ին մահուան դատապարտուեցաւ եւ մեռաւ Սմոլենսկի տաժանակիրներու բանտին մէջ։
bio_en: Vachagan Melikian (Vacho) was born in 1888 in Alapars in the Erivan governorate, the son of the village agha Nerses. As a gymnasium student in Yerevan he organised a revolutionary student circle and in 1905-06 was the soul of student gatherings. Persecuted from 1909, he was arrested through betrayal in Igdir in 1911 and taken to the Yerevan prison. On 6 May 1913 he was tried and sentenced to death, and he died in the Smolensk hard-labour prison just as news of his release arrived.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Death year not stated; text implies he died at the moment of the 1917 amnesty ('when they came to say he is free') - verify.
